description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `hovered-card-race` is refused by `race/read-after-action`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own point alone: over `_reference`, a case that passed; over `_two-points`, its race beside the paused sheen's bare wait, a case that fired more than it declares — the race comes first, so only that rule reports it; with `check` set to `baseline`, another check; with `rule` set to `wait-then-baseline`, another rule.
